scope: Only scratch authoring, source-byte hashing, and AST checks were performed. No project imports, generated-script execution, MBP access, sync, runtime tests, Git mutations, or commits.
guards: Pinned bindings, uploads, canonical runner, preserved HEAD, static manifest, and all 21 source files before remote work
Local wrong-source canary returns before importing the remote runner
Canonical mirror lock, pending-run reconciliation, prerequisite checks, retrying upload/sync, uploaded-byte verification
Remote wrong-source capture must exit 2 with subprocess_count 0 and no results.json before the positive capture
Exact current part inventory rejects stale activity_base before jobs; source hashes and part inventory checked again afterward
Every job records all 21 source hashes before launch and after completion; any mismatch stops the entire capture immediately. Unlaunched blocked jobs do not count as subprocesses.

ownership_canaries.acceptance: Only AssertionError at the exact intended assertion in the frozen standalone snippet counts. Original equipment-base objects are untouched. Failure stops the remaining capture jobs.

payloads.comparison: Whole raw file equality plus pinned baseline raw hashes and strict SHA256 body footers
payloads.plain_root: Empty unavailable control excluded from required 23

interpreter_semantics: Both outer lanes run the unchanged tests, including their original internal interpreter_cases loops. The mirrored Qt interpreter must resolve to the approved Qt interpreter.

timeouts.cleanup: Kill and reap only the timed-out job process group, including nested children

remaining: Parent execution after MBP ownership release

baseline_static_reverification.scope: Read retained local baseline bytes only; no runtime executed
